app.name: Wii Ran AI
app.short_description: Local stories and chat on your Wii
app.long_description: Stories, Nano Chat, or larger Medium Chat. Chat is experimental; replies may be wrong. Nano: 2,048 context / 128-token replies. Medium: 512 / 64. D-pad selects, A types, B deletes, Minus spaces, Plus generates, Home quits.
